fieldValues.title: Read as a human
fieldValues.summary: The rendered specification must make sense to a person reading it front to back. Rulings A and B of 2026-09-17 settle where the reading experience is assembled — order and membership at EXPRESSION, concepts describing themselves — and this wave applies them Part by Part. The exit criterion is a read-through by someone who did not write it, not a checker going green.
fieldValues.body:
## Why a fifth wave exists

The first four waves make the specification correct, measured, restructured and proven against a machine reader. None of them asks whether the rendered result reads. A corpus can be a valid concept tree, pass every declared check, and still land on a person as a list of definitions with no thread between them — which is the failure the whole programme was started to fix, arriving from the other side.

The exit criterion is deliberately not a metric. It is a read-through of the rendered specification, front to back, by someone who did not write it. Nothing in this wave is finished on the strength of a checker passing.

## What governs the rewrites

The owner rulings of 2026-09-17 (the-greenman/srs#787, comment 5712896993) govern every unit here.

Ruling A places order and membership for a story at EXPRESSION: `contains`, `precedes` and `depends-on` stay the one MEANING tree, while context membership and nesting are Containers and context order is the Composition section's `memberOrder`. A narrative is constructed from reusable parts, and the nested rendering path is instrumented from day one so the nesting can be measured and refined rather than guessed at.

Ruling B places the prose: concepts describe themselves in human-readable ways. Bridging and introductory text is the concept record's own prose rendered at its heading, and a Part introduction is the Part concept's prose. There is no narrative leaf type and no presentation-only text on the Composition.

Together they settle what would otherwise be relitigated in every rewrite unit: the reading experience is assembled at the expression layer, out of records that already say what they are.

## The units

Planning comes first — a read-through of the rendered specification that proposes the rewrite units rather than assuming them. Then nine per-Part rewrites, one Part at a time, each cut against rulings A and B. Then a readability check, so that what the read-through found does not have to be found again by hand. Then the proof: another read-through, by another reader who did not write it.
